I sense your fear. It smells like smoke.
Feel that heat? That is only my breath.
t.GRUKH DRTIT! Malé stvoření, dobrá svačin: GRUKH SMASH! Little creature, good snack!
Mountains do not move. But I do.
t.Každá nit v této síni vede ke mně. I ta: Every thread in this hall leads to me. Even yours.
t.Kdo se opovažuje rušit spánek krále? Mé: Who dares disturb the king's sleep? My bones remember a thousand battles.
t.Klekni před svým králem… nebo se k mé ar: Kneel before your king… or join my army as a skeleton.
t.Koruna je těžká. Tvoje lebka by jí ale s: The crown is heavy. But your skull would wear it well.
t.Malý tvore, tvé zlato zazvoní v mé sluji: Little creature, your gold will jingle in my lair.
t.Mé děti mají hlad. A ty voníš tak… sladc: My children are hungry. And you smell so… sweet.
The night is long and I am thirsty.
The flames of hell are already waiting for you.
t.Popel k popelu. Brzy z tebe zbude jen hr: Ashes to ashes. Soon nothing will be left of you but a little pile.
t.Přísahal jsem bránit tuto bránu. I po sm: I swore to defend this gate. Even in death.
I will crush you like a pebble.
t.Smrt je jen začátek. Dovol, abych ti to: Death is only the beginning. Allow me to show you.
t.Tasíš zbraň proti stínu? Odvážné. A marn: You draw your weapon against a shadow? Bold. And futile.
t.Tisíc let jsem spal na svém pokladu. Neb: I slept on my treasure for a thousand years. Waking me will not go unpunished.
Your soul will shine in my phylactery.
Your heart beats so fast. I will slow it.
t.Tvoje zbroj bude Grukhova trofej!: Your armor will be Grukh's trophy!
t.Umírat hlasitě, ano? Grukh má rád hluk!: Die loud, yes? Grukh like noise!
t.Uvízneš v mé síti stejně jako všichni př: You will get stuck in my web just like everyone before you.
Everything dissolves in the end. Even you.
Rise, my faithful. We have a guest.
t.…děkuji… Už zase slyším strom. Zpívá…: …thank you… I can hear the tree again. It is singing…
t.„…pomoc… maminko… ne. NE. Všechno je tak: “…help… Mama… no. NO. Everything is just as it should be. The Lord of the Depths showed me the truth.”
t.„Den první. Krypta je starší, než jsem č: “Day one. The crypt is older than I expected. The coffin lids bear the marks of the Five. Mama would be so happy that I can finally see them with my own eyes.”
t.„Houby tu dýchají. Místní tvorové šeptaj: “The mushrooms breathe here. The creatures who live here whisper about the Spore Mother, who is growing around the second lock like mold. They say she used to be human.”
t.„Isolda mě pustila dál. Plakala ledovými: “Isolda let me pass. She wept tears of ice and begged me to go back up. I did not listen to her.”
t.„Konečně tomu rozumím. Pečeť není vězení: “At last I understand. The seal is not a prison for him. It is a prison for us – so that the world above never learns what true power is.”
t.„Matku spor nezastavím. Obešla jsem ji p: “I can't stop the Spore Mother. I went around her by way of the underground river. The lock will have to wait… or be left to someone else.”
t.„Morgrim mě nechtěl pustit. Spoutala jse: “Morgrim did not want to let me through. I bound him with the seal and he knelt. He said: ‘Go, daughter of Svatava. I will stay here forever.’ I felt sorry for him.”
t.„Pavouci mi vzali lucernu i s kusem pláš: “The spiders took my lantern, along with a piece of my cloak. I can't hear Mama anymore. It is so quiet here that I can hear my own heart.”
t.„Skřeti tu mají celé tržiště. Nechali mě: “The goblins have a whole marketplace here. They let me through for three pastries. Mama's pastries work even down here.”
t.„Ve sklepech utopeného města jsou pořád: “There are still heaps of silver in the cellars of the drowned city. Nobody took any. Probably because down here the silver screams when you touch it.”
t.„Ve snu slyším hlas. Volá mě jménem. Ví,: “In my dream I hear a voice. It calls me by name. It knows why I came. It even knows about Mama.”
t.Bereš mi moje hračky. Nevadí. Najdu si n: You are taking my toys. Never mind. I will find a new one – you.
t.Bořiv prý do každého zámku vložil kus vl: They say Borin put a piece of his own heart into every lock. That is why the seal held for a thousand years.
t.Brána podsvětí se otevřela s rachotem ře: The Gate of the Underworld swung open with a clatter of chains. Behind it stood a giant in rusty armor, with a sword as long as a bridge.
Black glass, rivers of lava and thousands of reflections. In each of them, something moves that is not in the cave.
t.Chodba končí branou vysokou jako hora. V: The corridor ends at a gate as tall as a mountain. Chains as thick as trees hang from it, and behind the bars the underworld blazes.
t.Cítím tě až tady nahoře. Celá vesnice dr: I can feel you all the way up here. The whole village keeps lanterns in its windows. We are shining for you. Come back to us.
t.Cítím to! První zámek drží a Isolda je k: I can feel it! The first lock holds and Isolda is finally free. Go on – and take care of yourself.
t.Čtyři střepy pečeti se rozzářily a spáli: The four seal shards lit up and burned away the shadow that Nyx'thar was hiding in.
t.Čtyři střepy se rozzářily a spojily v je: The four shards lit up and merged into a single ring of light. Nyx'thar roared – and for the first time in a thousand years, the darkness withdrew.
Another little light in my darkness. Come closer. Show me how brightly you can burn.
Thank you… At last I feel warmth.
t.Díky tobě jsem zase sama sebou. Maminka: Thanks to you, I am myself again. Mama sent you, didn't she? How is she?
t.Dno světa leží dvě stě padesát pater pod: The bottom of the world lies two hundred and fifty floors below us. Every ten floors form a different world, and at the end of each ten a guardian waits.
t.Dno světa se otřásá. Tohle je poslední b: The bottom of the world is shaking. This is the final battle.
t.Dno světa. Pod nohama už není kámen, jen: The Bottom of the World. Underfoot there is no longer stone, only black glass – and beneath it, something enormous is slowly drawing breath.
t.Do kovadliny je vyryto: „Pečeť nezlomí s: Carved into the anvil: “The seal cannot be broken by strength, only by a heart that gives up. Whoever makes it this far – do not give up.” – Borin, smith of the Five
t.Do trůnu je vytesáno: „Kopali jsme pro P: Carved into the throne: “We dug for the Five, we dug for the light. But the depths dug against us.” – Grimbold, last king of the Deep Clan
t.Dodržel slovo. Pojď blíž. I ty tu budeš: He kept his word. Come closer. You, too, will serve here forever.
t.Druhý zámek je obnoven a Květa našla kli: The second lock is restored and Flora has found peace. Elara came through here, didn't she? I can feel her… she is still alive. Hurry.
t.Dva zámky drží. Třetí je u Brány podsvět: Two locks hold. The third is at the Gate of the Underworld, guarded by Morgrim, a knight of the Five. He swore that no one would pass through the gate. I fear he keeps that oath to this day.
t.Elařina pečeť ti dává trvalé požehnání:: Elara's Seal grants you a permanent blessing: +10% health and +10% damage.
t.Elařiny oči zčernaly. Jejími ústy promlu: Elara's eyes turned black. Someone else spoke through her lips.
t.Grot hlídá vězně pána Morgrima. Nikdo z: Grot guards Lord Morgrim's prisoners. No one leaves the ossuary. Not the dead. Not the living.
t.Hlídali jsme tu bránu tři sta let. Pak k: We guarded this gate for three hundred years. Then a voice spoke to us down here and promised us eternity.
t.Hlubina snů. Zdají se tu sny všem, kdo k: The Abyss of Dreams. Everyone who ever fell asleep beneath the mountain dreams here – monks, miners, dwarves and the Five alike.
t.Hora se otřásla naposledy. Pak nastalo t: The mountain shook one last time. Then came silence – true silence.
t.Houby tu rostou do výšky stromů a svítí: Mushrooms here grow as tall as trees and glow like lanterns. Spores fall like snow – and wherever they land, something hungry sprouts.
t.Isolda se rozplynula v jemném sněžení. T: Isolda dissolved into a gentle snowfall. Where she had stood, a glowing shard lay – the first lock of the seal shone again.
t.Isolda zvedla ruce a ledová síň se zapln: Isolda raised her hands and the ice hall filled with a blizzard.
t.Je tam. Cítím ji. Moje Elara… Ale není s: She is there. I can feel her. My Elara… But she is not alone. That voice is with her.
t.Jenže tisíc let je dlouhá doba. Jeho hla: But a thousand years is a long time. His voice seeps through the rock and turns the guardians into monsters. The locks are cracking.
t.Jestli chceš dál, musíš mě porazit. Pros: If you want to go on, you must defeat me. Please… defeat me.
t.Jestli mi ji vezmeš, vezmu si tebe. Tak: If you take her from me, I will take you. So come.
t.Jestli padnu, vezmu tvé světlo s sebou!: If I fall, I will take your light with me!
t.Jsem Morgrim z Pětice. Přísahal jsem, že: I am Morgrim of the Five. I swore that no one would pass through the gate. No one!
t.Kapitola III – Brána podsvětí: Chapter III – Gate of the Underworld
t.Kapitola V – Dno světa: Chapter V – Bottom of the World
t.Katakomby. Zdi tu nejsou z kamene, ale z: The Catacombs. The walls here are not stone but skulls – thousands of empty eyes watch every step.
Where… where am I? That voice… it's gone.
t.Kdysi… jsem měla jméno… Květa… Ne. Teď j: Once… I had a name… Flora… No. Now I am MOTHER. And you will be SOIL.
t.Klíče… Grot ztratil klíče…: The keys… Grot lost the keys…
t.Konečně jsi blízko. Slyším tvé srdce. Bi: At last you are near. I can hear your heart. It beats so fast…
t.Konečně jsi tady. Jmenuji se Ilda. Celý: You are finally here. My name is Ilda. All my life I have guarded a seal that no one wants to hear about anymore.
t.Konečně. Malé světýlko na samém dně mé t: At last. A little light at the very bottom of my darkness.
t.Konečně… ticho. Jeho hlas utichl. Tisíc: At last… silence. His voice has died away. For a thousand years I kept an oath that he stole from me long ago.
t.Kopali tak hluboko, až prokopali dno. Pa: They dug so deep that they broke through the bottom. Then came the water. It is rising to this day – and something swims in it that has no name.
t.Kořeny se zachvěly. Ze stropu se snesl d: The roots trembled. A rain of spores fell from the ceiling, and from the mycelium rose a huge figure overgrown with mushrooms.
t.Kořeny světa se zachvěly a vrhly se do b: The Roots of the World trembled and threw themselves into battle at the Spore Mother's side.
t.Kořeny tlusté jako věže prorůstají skálo: Roots as thick as towers grow through the rock. They belong to the tree that grows high above in the Gray Mountains – the oldest tree in the world.
t.Kosti tu šeptají. Pořád dokola jen jedno: The bones whisper here. Over and over, only one name: Morgrim.
t.Kostnice. Lustry z kostí, oltáře z lebek: The Ossuary. Chandeliers of bone, altars of skulls. Here lie those who did not make it through Morgrim's gate – and may not leave even in death.
t.Kostnicí se rozlehl rachot klíčů. Ze tmy: The rattle of keys echoed through the ossuary. Out of the darkness emerged a giant of bones in an iron mask, with chains wrapped around his arms.
t.Kovadliny vychladly a sochám králů chybí: The anvils have gone cold and the statues of kings have lost their heads. The dwarves are gone – or they dug too deep.
t.Kovárny Pětice. Tady kovář Bořiv sedm dn: The Forges of the Five. Here the smith Borin forged the seal for seven days and seven nights. The anvils glow to this day – they beat to the rhythm of an alien heart.
t.Králové pouště mi sloužili rádi. Za věčn: The kings of the desert served me gladly. So little was needed for eternal life. They only had to give me everything.
t.Kruh klíčů dopadl na zem a všechny cely: The ring of keys hit the ground and every cell in the ossuary swung open at once. The bones breathed a sigh of relief.
t.Krypta končí rozbitou zdí. Za ní začínaj: The crypt ends at a broken wall. Beyond it begin caves that no one ever dug. Water drips here, and mushrooms glow in the dark.
t.Kusy skal plují v prázdnotě jako ostrovy: Chunks of rock drift in the void like islands in a black sea. Bridges made of nothing arch between them.
t.Květa zapletla druhý zámek do kořenů, ab: Flora wove the second lock into the roots so that no one would find it. But from here I can feel only rot… and something that is growing.
t.Led na Isoldině hrudi praskl a odhalil s: The ice on Isolda's chest cracked, revealing a heart of blue crystal.
t.Matka spor se roztrhla – a z jejího nitr: The Spore Mother burst open – and new, poisonous shoots erupted from within her!
t.Mlč! On mi dal moc. A ty mi ji nevezmeš!: Silence! He gave me power. And you will not take it from me!
t.Mniši z krypty… Konečně mají klid. Pokra: The monks of the crypt… They are finally at peace. Keep going, you are on the right path.
t.Moje dcera je doma. Hora mlčí. A to všec: My daughter is home. The mountain is silent. And all of it is thanks to you.
t.MOJE PAŽE! Ty… ty malé světlo…!: MY ARMS! You… you little light…!
t.Morgrim mi slíbil věrnost dřív, než o to: Morgrim promised me his loyalty before he even knew it. Every oath is a chain. And I hold every end.
t.Morgrimova zbroj se rozžhavila doruda. Z: Morgrim's armor glowed red-hot. Flames of the underworld lashed from the eye slits of his helmet.
t.Morgrimovo brnění se rozpadlo v prach. U: Morgrim's armor crumbled to dust. The third seal shard lay in the middle of it.
t.Myslíš, že mě porazíš? Je nás víc!: You think you can defeat me? There are more of us!
t.Na dně světa se tma pohnula. Otevřelo se: At the bottom of the world, the darkness stirred. An eye opened, as big as a castle gate.
t.Na dveřích hrobky stojí: „Kdo vezme zlat: The tomb door reads: “Whoever takes the king's gold shall remain with the king.”
t.Na obzoru stojí černá věž. Stínová citad: A black tower stands on the horizon. The Shadow Citadel. Once the light of Svatava's order burned in it. Now only darkness comes out of it.
t.Na oltáři stojí: „Světlo není to, co sví: The altar reads: “Light is not that which shines. Light is that which never surrenders to the dark.” – Svatava
t.Na povrchu svítalo. Celá vesnice stála u: Dawn was breaking on the surface. The whole village stood at the gate holding lit lanterns.
t.Na stěně jsou čerstvé značky skřetů. A p: There are fresh goblin marks on the wall. And beneath them an older one, scratched in with a knife: “E. → down.”
I offer you more than they will ever give you up there. Eternity. Power. All you have to do is stop and listen.
t.Nad branou kostnice je vytesáno: „Padli: Carved above the ossuary gate: “We fell so that others might live. Do not weep for us – go on.”
t.Ne… střepy… ty máš všechny čtyři…: No… the shards… you have all four…
t.Nebudu se ani namáhat. Ukaž mi, jak dlou: I will not even bother. Show me how long you can shine.
t.Nedívej se dolů. Já se jednou podívala…: Don't look down. I looked once… and the voice almost pulled me down with it.
t.Někde mezi nimi je i sen malé holky z Lo: Somewhere among them is also the dream of a little girl from Loppo who wanted to save the world.
t.Nemám dost sil jít s tebou. Ale dám ti s: I don't have the strength to go with you. But I will give you my seal – it will protect you. And the fourth shard is yours.
t.Nepotřebuju, aby mě někdo zachraňoval. P: I don't need anyone to save me. The Lord of the Depths showed me the truth. Get out of my way!
t.Neubráním se… jeho mráz je silnější než: I cannot resist… his frost is stronger than I am. Run while you still can!
A new prisoner! Grot has a cell for you.
t.Obří síně vytesané do skály. Trpaslíci z: Giant halls carved into the rock. The dwarves of the Deep Clan once dug the Five a way down here.
t.Ona už je moje. Její světlo tak krásně h: She is already mine. Her light burns so beautifully in my citadel. Come and see.
t.Opat se rozpadl v prach a jeho kosti kon: The abbot crumbled to dust, and his bones finally came to rest.
t.Pak se země začala třást. Ze studní stou: Then the ground began to shake. Black smoke rose from the wells, and at night monsters crept out of the old crypt beneath the castle ruins.
t.Palác ze zrcadel. Každé ukazuje někoho j: A palace of mirrors. Each one shows someone different – a king, a beggar, a monster. None of them shows the truth.
t.Pátý zámek je na samém dně světa. Nyx'th: The fifth lock is at the very bottom of the world. Nyx'thar has almost freed himself there.
t.Pátý zámek pečeti sevřel Nyx'tharova cha: The fifth lock of the seal clamped down on Nyx'thar's tentacles – and severed them with a thunderclap.
t.Pavučiny visí přes chodby jako opony. V: Cobwebs hang across the corridors like curtains. The cocoons hold the remains of adventurers… and among them a lantern bearing the mark of the Five.
This time the seal did not close around him. It swallowed him whole. The Lord of the Depths vanished forever.
t.Pětice mě spoutala na tisíc let. Tisíc l: The Five bound me for a thousand years. For a thousand years I have been waiting for someone to make it all the way here.
t.Pětice mě… jen spoutala… Ty… ty mě…: The Five… only bound me… You… you…
t.Písek? Tak hluboko pod horou? Kdysi tu p: Sand? This deep beneath the mountain? A desert once lay here, they say – before the rock closed over it. Its kings had themselves buried with their gold and a curse.
t.Pod hladinou podzemního jezera stojí kat: A cathedral stands beneath the surface of the underground lake. It was built by Svatava, priestess of the Five – Ilda's ancient ancestress.
t.Pod katakombami leží utopené město. Žili: A drowned city lies beneath the catacombs. Miners lived here, mining silver for the Five to forge the seal.
t.Pod kořeny se skála mění v krystal. Když: Beneath the roots the rock turns to crystal. When the light of a lantern falls on it, the whole cave sings.
t.Pod ledem se skála otevírá jako rána. Z: Beneath the ice the rock gapes open like a wound. Heat pours from the cracks and drumming echoes – demons are clawing their way up.
t.Pod zříceninou hradu začíná Stará krypta: The Old Crypt begins beneath the castle ruins. Monks once guarded the entrance to the depths here. Now only their bones stand guard.
t.Podívej – tady nosíš korunu. A tady jsi: Look – here you wear a crown. And here you are only a shadow. Choose what you want to be. I will grant it.
t.Poslední spory se snesly k zemi. Kořeny: The last spores drifted to the ground. For the first time in centuries, the Roots of the World drew a breath of clean air.
t.Před rokem sestoupila dolů moje dcera El: A year ago my daughter Elara went down to repair the seal. She never came back.
t.Před rokem tudy šla dívka s lucernou. El: A year ago a girl with a lantern came through here. Elara. I begged her to turn back. She did not. Find her before he does.
t.Před rokem tudy šla dívka s lucernou. Sv: A year ago a girl with a lantern came through here. She shone so brightly that we let her pass… Beware of Isolda. Her ice no longer recognizes friends.
t.Před tisíci lety spoutala Pětice – pět h: A thousand years ago, the Five – five heroes – bound Nyx'thar, the Lord of the Depths, beneath the mountain. The smith Borin forged a seal with five locks, and the Five placed them along the way down into the depths.
t.Přísaha hoří! A já s ní!: The oath burns! And I burn with it!
t.Prosím… ať se stane cokoli, neubližuj jí: Please… whatever happens, do not hurt her more than you have to. She is still my little girl.
t.První zámek drží, ale pečeť je jen tak s: The first lock holds, but a seal is only as strong as its weakest lock. The second is at the Roots of the World. It is guarded by Flora, a druid of the Five. Hurry.
t.Říká se, že pod dnem světa je ještě něco: They say there is still something beneath the bottom of the world. Depths older than Nyx'thar… But that is another story.
t.Rosteme… krmíme se… ON nás živí…: We grow… we feed… HE feeds us…
Break it… please. Only then will I be free.
t.Slyšíš mě? Moje pečeť tě chrání, ale na: Can you hear me? My seal protects you, but it cannot reach all the way to the bottom. Down there it will be up to you alone.
t.Slyšíš to? Kostnice ztichla. Zbývá už je: Do you hear that? The ossuary has fallen silent. Only Morgrim remains – and his gate.
t.Stínová citadela. Brány jsou otevřené do: The Shadow Citadel. The gates stand wide open – as if someone were expecting a visitor.
t.Stíny se rozprskly jako sklo. Elara kles: The shadows shattered like glass. Elara sank to her knees, and for the first time in a year, a light of her own kindled in her eyes.
t.Stůj. Tisíc let stojím na stráži prvního: Halt. For a thousand years I have stood guard over the first lock. For a thousand years his voice has chilled me from within.
t.Ta dívka mě spoutala pečetí a prošla. Po: That girl bound me with the seal and walked through. I will not allow it a second time. Fight – or turn back!
t.Ta dívka, Elara… šla do citadely. Tam je: That girl, Elara… went to the citadel. That is where his voice is strongest. Find her… before it is too late.
t.Ta světla… pálí! Dobře. Tak tedy dooprav: Those lights… they burn! Fine. Then for real this time.
t.Tady drží první zámek Isolda, čarodějka: Isolda, a sorceress of the Five, holds the first lock here. She was the kindest of them… If his voice has changed her, this will not be a fight you want to win. But you must.
t.Tady končí kámen. Dál vede jen pár mostů: The stone ends here. Only a few bridges over nothing lead on – and a darkness that remembers a time before there was light.
t.Tady pohřbívali ty, kdo padli v první vá: Here they buried those who fell in the first war with the depths. Show them respect. Most of them once fought for us.
t.Tady se modlila, než šla s ostatními dol: She prayed here before she went down with the others. Your lantern comes from here, too. Do you hear those bells under the water? They are ringing for you.
t.Takže tě maminka poslala za mnou. Jak do: So Mama sent you after me. How touching.
t.Ten hlas… lhal. Věčnost je jen dlouhá zi: That voice… lied. Eternity is only a long winter.
Warm green water, fog and the buzzing of flies. In the swamps everything rots – wood, stone, even time.
t.Tisíc let… nikdo neprošel… Nikdo… NEPROJ: A thousand years… no one has passed… No one… GETS THROUGH!
t.To je Elařina lucerna! Proto ji už rok n: That is Elara's lantern! That is why I haven't been able to hear her for a year. She lost it here… but she went on. She must have gone on.
t.Tohle byl jen můj stín. Teď uvidíš, co s: That was only my shadow. Now you will see what sleeps beneath the mountain!
t.Třetí zámek září. Ale moje dcera… ten hl: The third lock shines. But my daughter… that voice… No. I trust her. And I trust you.
t.Tři z nich zůstali dole jako strážci: ča: Three of them stayed below as guardians: the sorceress Isolda, the druid Flora and the knight Morgrim. The fourth lock was watched over by priests in the citadel, which still shone back then. The fifth lies right upon him.
t.Uprostřed katakomb stojí kazatelna z kos: In the middle of the catacombs stands a pulpit of bones. Behind it rose a tall, hooded shadow – the abbot of the monks who once guarded the entrance to the depths.
In the middle of the ice hall stands a throne of ice. A woman in a cloak of hoarfrost rose – and the whole dungeon rang.
t.Uprostřed podhoubí zůstal ležet druhý st: In the middle of the mycelium lay the second seal shard.
I no longer know whom I protect… Forgive me.
t.V bahně jsou otisky malých bot. Čas tu h: There are prints of small boots in the mud. Time rots so slowly here that they are still fresh – even after a year. They lead to the citadel.

Leather, gold, sometimes a frost ring.
t.Kyselá hmota, která se po zásahu rozpadn: An acidic mass that breaks into smaller pieces when hit.
t.Léčí ostatní goblíny a schovává se za ně: Heals other goblins and hides behind them. Kill it first.

Hunts in a pack, and its bite freezes.

Rarely anything – bats have no pockets.

Nothing – a swarm has no pockets.

t.Po smrti se rozpadne na dva menší golemy: When it dies, it splits into two smaller golems.

Victims' rings and lots of gold.

t.Skočí z dálky a otráví kousnutím. Jed mu: Leaps from a distance and poisons with its bite. Poison doesn't hurt it.

t.Teleportuje se k tobě, saje krev a když: Teleports to you, drinks your blood, and when things look grim, briefly breaks apart into bats.
Heavy weapons and armor, lots of gold.
t.Truhla se zuby. Kdo je chamtivý, ten na: A chest with teeth. Only the greedy would reach for it.
